checks.name: positive control: label is a known function of the features
AUROC overstates a mediocre predictor under class imbalance
checks.expectation: AUROC well above 0.5 while AUPRC and precision stay modest, demonstrating why AUROC is not reported alone
checks.interpretation: AUROC 0.795 looks strong, but the best achievable F1 is 0.400 with precision 0.358. The ROC false-positive-rate denominator is the large negative class, so many false positives barely move it.

checks.name: label shuffle (negative control): features carry no signal
checks.expectation: mean AUROC within 0.03 of 0.5 and mean AUPRC near the positive rate

checks.name: leakage by split level: residue vs protein vs homology cluster
checks.expectation: a residue-level split scores highest, a homology-separated split lowest; the differences quantify the leak

checks.name: leakage guard rejects a corrupted homology split
checks.expectation: raises LeakageError when a cluster spans train and test
checks.message: homology cluster(s) [1] appear in both train and test. Example members: [['121P', '1JAI', '1N6O', '1RVD']]. A test protein from a cluster the model trained on is not an unseen family, and every metric computed on this split would be optimistic.

checks.name: homology split verified directly against the sequences
checks.expectation: maximum train-test identity at or below the 30% threshold

checks.name: features are identical with and without the ligand present
checks.expectation: no ligand coordinate influences any feature
